kind: read-only fixed-source plugin host integration research
result: Future production integration acceptance only; not a blocker or scope amendment for current standalone six-scope QuickControls implementation. No feature completion claim.

observations.fact: MessageSettingsPicker is a controlled standalone interface; current production composer mounts the older locked creation-profile picker directly. No production MessageSettings contribution exists at this fixed base.

Existing chat.composer.actions button/menu and chat.composer.context panel slots already offer a real builtin adapter precedent; no additional global slot registry is justified just for message settings.

PluginView may retain a renderer inside hidden React Activity; activation stop aborts its signal. ResourceContext composer viewId/isDraft alone is not the opaque draft ownership or activation generation required to apply settings.

decisions.decision: At the later assigned production-host handoff, contribute the builtin opening action through existing composer slot and render the one controlled settings surface through a host-owned adapter. Opening may be plugin-dispatched; applying must cross the private synchronous host CAS seam. Keep raw clients, catalog authority, draft ownership token and setter out of serializable contribution args/ResourceContext. Do not add a public set-settings host command without a real authorized requirement.

Future adapter must bind current activation/connection/view authority, in addition to draft ownership. Capture the original activation signal or equivalent host-owned lease in the apply callback; reject calls after disable/unload, same-plugin reactivation, hidden/inactive view and connection replacement. Do not rely only on unmount, prop freshness or a live plugin id lookup; hidden Activity can retain the old renderer. Reuse existing activation lease instead of another global store.

Two contributed buttons opening the same composer must use one host-owned C draft and one settings edit session; they cannot allocate parallel authoritative settings stores. Existing sent A and queued B receipts remain immutable when an extension is hidden, disabled or re-enabled.

futureAcceptance: Current builtin and a sample alternate button open the same settings surface using existing slots without editing core Thread. Disable the plugin while a staged edit is open: close or invalidate the session, preserve C, and old Apply/omit cannot commit even after re-enable with same draft value.
Switch/hide the composer pane while the retained renderer exists; delayed old callback remains rejected. Return to the exact view through a new authorized open to edit normally.
Two entry buttons do not double-apply, fork C or duplicate catalog loads; applying uses exact declared tuple plus synchronous host CAS and cannot mutate A/B.
scope: No changes to current Picker props, App, Thread, P01, Recovery or shared contracts requested here. Host integration will need its own fresh owner/handoff before implementation.
checks: Only fixed Git blob reads and design review; no Node import, browser, service, resource sampling, PG, provider or tests.

cleanCode.applied: Keep one small controlled interface, private host authority and existing real adapter seam. Reject redundant public commands, slot registries and draft stores; specify observable lifecycle rejection checks.
cleanCode.unresolved: Exact production adapter signature awaits current Recovery/P01 host ownership handoff; no invented implementation or executed verification.
